'''Skorg Jameson''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] colonist from [[Sulon/Legends|Sulon]].

==Biography==
Skorg joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] to fight against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], he aimed to be elected the Rebel [[Sector Leader]] of [[Sullust/Legends|Sullustan Space]].

Morgan disliked him and considered him a sign of trouble. Skorg didn't like the idea that [[Kyle Katarn|Katarn's son]], one of the top Rebel leaders, was studying in the [[Carida Academy/Legends|Imperial Military Academy at Cliffside]], and considered him a potential danger for their cause.

It was when Katarn was repairing a pump relay when they had one such troubled meeting; soon after Sulon witnessed an assault from the ''[[Vengeance (Imperial-class, Jerec)|Vengeance]]'' where several homesteads were destroyed. Skorg considered that they were an attempt to attack the [[Geothermal tap|G-Tap]], to force the population of Sulon to depend on [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]], and his well-rehearsed speech convinced the other Rebel leaders to strike back in an open warfare.

He was one of the twenty-six Rebel resistance soldiers that were killed during [[Jerec (Inquisitor)|Jerec's]] attack.

==Character and traits==
Skorg was a big figure, with a tall and strong body, bulging chest and wide legs. His shaggy hair touched his choulders. His speech was marked not only by his loud voice, but also his gestures and movements.

He took an aggressive stance against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], conflicting with the more covert action favored by [[Morgan Katarn]]. His ambitions to become a Leader, and his political experience made him a convincing orator, and he had supporters in the Sulon Rebel cell.

==Behind the scenes==
In [[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire (audio drama)|the audio adaptation ''Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire'']], Jameson is voiced by [[Bob Davis]].
